says: A name_taken start refusal carries only its tag, so fabsh cannot tell the person which program's process holds the name.
proof: next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/StartChild.ts:34 declares StartRefusal as Schema.Literals([...]) with no fields, and the start_child_err message gives the window only msg.error._tag, so fabsh's refusal text can name the name and the program it tried but not the owner.
cost: A person who meets name_taken has to look for the owner by hand before they can pick another name or stop the other process.
